FN-HG1MP83-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 91
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/08/2026
House Bill 91 as introduced would allow certain existing docket fees that are currently allocated
to the sheriff’s office to be used for the operation of the jail to instead be used for law
enforcement purposes. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
In Fiscal Year 2024, an estimated cumulative total of $605,578 of these fees were disbursed to
sheriffs (average $9,000 per county).
